_note: Regression floor for frozen external holdout #1. CI fails if recall drops
below the floor, so a ranking change can no longer silently regress this
suite the way two already did.
The floor is deliberately set to what main CURRENTLY scores, not to the
target. Holdout #1 scored 1.0/1.0 at 3462828 and regressed twice since:
7acb0d8 'align structural leaf gates with query tokenization'
Because zod-email-regex still finds a same-named symbol outside the expected
file, scoped symbol recall is exactly 2/3 and is gated separately from bare recall.
Both regressions landed while this suite ran nowhere, which is what this gate fixes.
Raise floors back toward the targets only when independent root-cause fixes
improve them. Do NOT tune ranking against this suite to move these numbers --
it is a burned holdout and the project's protocol treats it as a regression
floor only. --update-floor is monotonic and refuses to lower any threshold.
